**Calculations:**

Mean average = (sum observation × frequency)/(total frequency)

= (1×3+2×2+3×2+4×5+5×5+6×4+7×6+8×3+9×5+10×3+11×1)/(39)

= (3+4+6+20+25+24+42+24+45+30+11)/(39)

= (234)/(39) = 6

therefore** The Required mean average is 6.**
